text:
Nimbus Labs is a fast-growing fintech startup building low-latency payments infrastructure for challenger banks. We move fast, care deeply about quality, and need an SDET to own end-to-end test automation that keeps our production reliability at 99.999%.

What you'll do
- Design, build and maintain automated test suites for web and API surfaces.
- Implement Selenium-based UI automation and create robust Page Object patterns.
- Develop and execute API tests using Postman collections and integrate them into CI.
- Author TestNG test frameworks, reporting and CI pipelines to run regression and smoke suites.
- Collaborate with engineers and product to translate requirements into test strategies and acceptance criteria.
- Triage and debug flaky tests, analyze failures, and drive fixes to reduce test maintenance overhead.
- Mentor engineers on testability and help build a culture of automated quality.

What we need (mandatory)
- Selenium
- Postman
- TestNG
- 4-7 years experience

Bonus points (preferred/good-to-have)
- Cypress
- pytest
- JUnit
- Test Automation

Location and work mode
Mumbai, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
